Frost bite caused Paddington to lose both front paws, so new prosthetics get him up and about. Chooch is a police dog needing a brace to get back to work patrolling the streets of Pittsburgh.
Buddy was brought to a rescue in Pennsylvania from Kentucky and gets a brace to help him walk again. Rigby is still healing from her torn achilles, and a leg brace helps speed up the process.
Cleo is a lovable pup from Delaware needing a brace to fix an injured back leg. Hannibull is a one of a kind pitbull cadaver dog who gets a brace to keep working.
Teddy Bear, a Samoyed from Maine, gets a prosthetic for a missing rear paw. Lola Gray learns how to swim again after getting a brace.
